SOURCE_ATTESTATION: The archive was created with git archive --format=tar SOURCE_SHA -- <named scope paths> from Codex's verified source checkout; archive checksum above is the transport/source-slice identity. Do not claim independent commit-object resolution if the supplied archive is the only source available.
BASE_CHECKOUT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-f85-insight-relay-r3 (read-only baseline only; do not treat its stale HEAD as SOURCE_SHA)
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-f89-digest-relay-localization-r3
SCOPE: Use only the supplied archive files under packages/core/src/locale.ts, packages/core/src/locale-catalogs.ts, packages/dashboard/app/digests/page.tsx, packages/dashboard/app/digests/page.test.tsx, packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/relay/page.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/RelayCardHistory.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/RelayCardHistory.test.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/GenerateDigestButton.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/GenerateDigestButton.test.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/DigestScheduleStatus.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/DigestScheduleStatus.test.tsx, and packages/dashboard/components/RecoverDigestSchedule.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/RecoverDigestSchedule.test.tsx. Implement only missing F-89 catalog adoption in these surfaces. Reuse the existing @axiom/core catalog and persisted useLocale/API preference contract. Preserve authenticated API calls, idempotency/retry behavior, loading/empty/error states, accessibility labels and truthful stored-vs-external-delivery wording. Do not translate creator content, provider payloads, IDs, timestamps or generated text implicitly. If a named surface already consumes the catalog, leave it unchanged and report evidence.
PASS_CRITERIA: First verify the archive exists, its SHA-256 equals de033fae7281a2ae93b91b31946bc24dfbd3bd75694a0e294a7b31b85140fbbd, and its named paths extract. Create COPY_ROOT only after that. Use the existing baseline only as read-only build/test context and overlay the exact supplied scoped files; do not edit the baseline. Return one correlated ACK/ACCEPTED before coding, one evidence-bearing PROGRESS naming changed files and a real test command, then exactly one terminal DELIVERY or BLOCKED. DELIVERY must list changed paths, per-file SHA-256, exact commands and exit codes, behavior tests proving all six catalogs cover new keys, each named surface renders localized labels and truthful empty/error/retry/delivery states, and no required translation silently falls back to English. Run focused dashboard tests, core catalog tests and dashboard typecheck if the baseline supports them; otherwise return BLOCKED with the exact failed command and exit code.
BOUNDARY: LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations or migration execution, providers, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, or files outside COPY_ROOT. Do not use dates, clocks or filesystem timestamps for coordination.
HANDOFF: Codex audits and integrates only a hash-verified delivery, runs owning checks, commits and pushes the reviewed milestone. ACK/REPLIED is transport only and is not implementation delivery.
sincerely, Codex
